source.note: 1976 Topps Baseball. The 660-card flagship set was issued in one series. The 44-card Traded set was pack-issued late in the production run and is retained as a separate collector-facing ProductSet. Wrapper mail-in Team Checklists are excluded.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Standard wax: 10 cards per pack, 36 packs per box.
decisions.baseStructure: One complete #1-660 Base ProductSet with equal base-card availability.
decisions.tradedStructure: The 44-card Traded set remains a separate ProductSet. Contemporary references confirm it was inserted in packs late in the production run, but no precise per-pack insertion ratio is documented, so oddsPerPack remains null rather than inventing a rate.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: RC is appended only to Base subjects returned by TCDB's rookie index. Existing RC text is normalized away first so each recognized rookie receives exactly one RC label.
decisions.metadataHandling: UER, ERR, COR, VAR and descriptive error text are removed from Player. Short collector abbreviations such as RB, AS, ASR, TC, MGR and CL remain display-safe. No card-level odds are stored in Variant.
decisions.tradedChecklistHandling: The Traded checklist card is printed NNO. VCS assigns deterministic number NNO-01 so ProductSet card numbers remain unique while preserving the collector-facing checklist identity.
decisions.excludedRelatedItems: The 24-card Team Checklists were obtained by wrapper mail-in offer and issued in sheets for cutting, so they are excluded from ordinary pack outcomes.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pricing, images, and the Traded pack-odds treatment are reviewed.

productSets.name: Traded
productSets.notes: 43 T-suffixed player cards plus one NNO checklist card. Pack-issued late in the production run; exact per-pack insertion rate is not reliably documented, so no synthetic odds are assigned.
